I'm definitely on (2,7) with the notice board. The Player Tester is at (3,7) — right next to me. 

Wait — maybe the Player Tester is what's blocking me from moving right, but not up/down/left. Yet all directions are blocked. 

Let me reconsider: the pathfinder said "in the way: Notice Board at (2,7)". This means the board is treated as an obstacle at my own tile, so the pathfinder can't even start. But physically, can I step off? The blockedMs test said blocked in all directions.

Let me try a very specific thing: maybe I need to interact with the notice board to read it, and reading it is done by pressing E while the board is in front. What if the board is actually at (2,6) or (2,8) and the observe is mislabeling? The map shows '.' at (2,6) and (2,8). 

Let me try pressing E facing each of the 4 directions and see if any reads the notice.
